---
title: "MCP tools"
description: >
  Every tool the server exposes to the LLM, with the description and
  arguments the LLM sees.
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, results = "asis")

# This page is generated from the tool definitions themselves, so it always
# matches what the server exposes to the LLM.
tools <- entsoeapi.mcp:::all_tools()
tool_names <- vapply(
  X = tools, FUN = \(t) attr(x = t, which = "name"), FUN.VALUE = character(1L)
)

# Section of each tool; a tool missing from this list lands under "Other".
sections <- list(
  "EIC lookup and news" = c(
    "area_eic", "party_eic", "all_approved_eic", "resource_object_eic",
    "get_news"
  ),
  "Load" = "load",
  "Generation" = c("gen_time_series", "gen_capacity"),
  "Market" = c(
    "energy_prices", "intraday_prices", "net_transfer_capacities",
    "day_ahead_commercial_sched", "explicit_offered_transfer_capacities",
    "flow_based_allocations", "congestion_income",
    "allocated_transfer_capacities_3rd_countries"
  ),
  "Transmission" = c(
    "cross_border_physical_flows", "total_commercial_sched",
    "net_positions", "forecasted_transfer_capacities"
  ),
  "Outages" = c(
    "outages_gen_units", "outages_prod_units", "outages_transmission_grid"
  ),
  "Balancing" = c(
    "imbalance_prices", "imbalance_volumes", "contracted_reserves"
  ),
  "Session DuckDB cache" = c("sql_query", "list_tables", "describe_table")
)
sections[["Other"]] <- setdiff(tool_names, unlist(sections))

# markdown table cells must not contain pipes or line breaks
cell <- \(x) {
  gsub(pattern = "\\|", replacement = "\\\\|", x = gsub("\n", " ", x))
}

render_tool <- function(tool) {
  cat("### `", attr(x = tool, which = "name"), "`\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(attr(x = tool, which = "description"), "\n\n", sep = "")
  args <- attr(x = tool, which = "arguments")@properties
  if (length(args) == 0L) {
    cat("*No arguments.*\n\n")
    return(invisible())
  }
  cat("| Argument | Required | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n")
  for (nm in names(args)) {
    cat(
      "| `", nm, "` | ", if (isTRUE(args[[nm]]@required)) "yes" else "no",
      " | ", cell(args[[nm]]@description), " |\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }
  cat("\n")
}
```

The server exposes **`r length(tools)` tools**. The time-series tools store
their full result in a session DuckDB table and return a short summary that
points at it. The LLM then uses `sql_query` to aggregate, filter or join.
The EIC lookup tools and `get_news` return CSV directly. All dates are
`YYYY-MM-DD`, interpreted in CET.

The descriptions below are exactly what the LLM reads when it decides which
tool to call and how.

```{r tools}
for (section in names(sections)) {
  in_section <- tools[tool_names %in% sections[[section]]]
  if (length(in_section) == 0L) next
  cat("## ", section, "\n\n", sep = "")
  for (tool in in_section) render_tool(tool)
}
```
